title: laportea divaricata
intro: Laportea divaricata, commonly known as the Woodland Nettle, is a species of flowering plant in the nettle family, Urticaceae. The Woodland Nettle has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce pain and improve overall well-being. The bioactive constituents of Laportea divaricata include flavonoids, glycosides, and alkaloids, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as antimicrobial, antipyretic, and anti-inflammatory activities. Additionally, the plant's leaves have been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and skin irritations.
